inject_sweep_callable_without_delegateca.meaning: injectSweepAndCall is a normal external function with no onlyDelegatecall or equivalent restriction, so it is callable outside a delegatecall context

router_holds_user_funds.meaning: users have sent funds to the router expecting stateless routing, so the router holds accumulated user funds

attacker_withdraws_router_balances.meaning: an attacker withdraws tokens from the router and drains the accumulated balances held there

assumptions: injectSweepAndCall is invoked directly on the router contract rather than via delegatecall from a wallet/shim.
The drain relies on the previously reported missing Delegatecall Guard bug; no separate attacker authorization for injectSweepAndCall is stated.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete amounts, token types, or numeric bounds for the accumulated or drained balances; the drain is expressed as a Boolean outcome.
Report does not state a concrete attacker authorization or permissionless-call fact for injectSweepAndCall itself; the drain depends on a separate previously reported bug.

limitations: Funds loss versus mere custody depends on TARGET behavior, which the report leaves conditional.
The impact is formalized as a Boolean drain outcome because no numeric magnitudes are reported.
